title: deutzia × carnea
intro: Deutzia × carnea, commonly known as 'Pride of Rochester', is a hybrid flowering plant in the hydrangea family (Hydrangeaceae). It is known for its showy, fragrant flowers, which are a key feature in its ornamental value. The health benefits of Deutzia × carnea include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can contribute to its therapeutic actions in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Deutzia × carnea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
